newsitem.title: USA: Noland says reaching yr sales goal unlikely.
newsitem.headline: Noland says reaching yr sales goal unlikely.

text.p: Noland Co said Wednesday it should see a rebound in air conditioning sales in the third quarter, with the arrival of hot summer weather, but its first-half performance makes it unlikely that it will meet its sales and profit targets for the year.

The company said its lower earnings in the second quarter came from a decline in sales stemming from "soft" air conditioning equipment sales and lower-than-expected performance by its newer operations.
It also said the "unusually cool spring" reduced demand for replacement air conditioning equipment.
Sales for the quarter were $117.7 million compared with $124.6 for the same period a year ago.
Earnings per share for the quarter were $0.18 versus $0.58.
The company said it is working to overcome obstacles to sales growth in underperforming branches, including newer operations.
It said it has "every reason to believe" it can improve on the second quarter's sales performance.
